pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū bahū patte sannicayaṃ karonti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:1.3: manussā vihāracārikaṃ āhiṇḍantā passitvā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:1.4: “kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā sakyaputtiyā bahū patte sannicayaṃ karissanti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:1.5: pattavāṇijjaṃ vā samaṇā sakyaputtiyā karissanti, āmattikāpaṇaṃ vā pasāressantī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:1.6: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:1.7: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:1.8: “kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū atirekapattaṃ dhāressantī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:1.9: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:1.13: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā atirekapattaṃ dhāressatha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:1.15: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:1.16.1: “yo pana bhikkhu atirekapattaṃ dhāreyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyanti.”
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:1.17: evañcidaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:2.1: [mūlapaññatti.] tena kho pana samayena āyasmato ānandassa atirekapatto uppanno hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:2.2: āyasmā ca ānando taṃ pattaṃ āyasmato sāriputtassa dātukāmo hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:2.10: kathannu kho mayā paṭipajjitabbanti.” atha kho āyasmā ānando
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:2.14: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:2.16: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:2.17.1: “dasāhaparamaṃ atirekapatto dhāretabbo. taṃ atikkāmayato, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyanti.”
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:3.7: tayo pattassa vaṇṇā: ukkaṭṭho patto majjhimo patto omako patto.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:3.8: ukkaṭṭho nāma patto aḍḍhāḷhakodanaṃ gaṇhāti catubhāgaṃ khādanaṃ tadupiyaṃ vyañjanaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:3.9: majjhimo nāma patto nāḷikodanaṃ gaṇhāti catubhāgaṃ khādanaṃ tadupiyaṃ vyañjanaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:3.10: omako nāma patto patthodanaṃ gaṇhāti catubhāgaṃ khādanaṃ tadupiyaṃ vyañjanaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:3.14: nissajitabbo saṅghassa vā gaṇassa vā puggalassa vā
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:3.16: tena bhikkhunā saṅghaṃ upasaṅkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā buḍḍhānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pāde vanditvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evamassa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:3.23: ayaṃ patto itthannāmassa bhikkhuno nissaggiyo saṅghassa nissaṭṭho,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:3.24: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ, saṅgho imaṃ pattaṃ itthannāmassa bhikkhuno dadeyyā”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:3.25: tena bhikkhunā sambahule bhikkhū upasaṅkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā buḍḍhānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pāde vanditvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evamassu vacanīyā:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:3.32: ayaṃ patto itthannāmassa bhikkhuno nissaggiyo āyasmantānaṃ nissaṭṭho.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:3.33: yadāyasmantānaṃ pattakallaṃ, āyasmantā imaṃ pattaṃ itthannāmassa bhikkhuno dadeyyu”nti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:3.34: tena bhikkhunā ekaṃ bhikkhuṃ upasaṅkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evamassa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:3.51: nissaggiyaṃ pattaṃ anissajjitvā paribhuñjati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:3.56: antodasāhaṃ adhiṭṭhāti, vikappeti, vissajjeti, nassati, vinassati, bhijjati, acchinditvā gaṇhanti, vissāsaṃ gaṇhanti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:4.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū nissaṭṭhapattaṃ na denti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np21:4.3: “na bhikkhave nissaṭṭhapatto na dātabbo. yo na dadeyya, āpatti dukkaṭassā”ti.
